name: Global Uniques
uniques: Reveals the entire map <upon turn start> <before turn number [2]>

civilopediaText.text: Roads have bridges over the creeks, and marching columns move three times as fast on them.
Armies are supplied by their trains: units cost no gold upkeep.
Both commanders have maps of the country: the whole terrain is revealed at the start, but enemy troops are only seen when your own units can see them.
Difficulty changes the fighting strength of computer-controlled armies: -15% on Militia, -5% on Volunteers, normal on Veterans, +10% on Regulars and +20% on Iron Brigade.
